BAUER KOMPRESSOREN 3CLEANUP DAY A diver rises out of the turbid wa- ters of the Danube, holding an e-scoo- ter covered in mud and algae. It’s one of a total of seven rescued from the water during “3Cleanup Days”, a clean- up campaign in Vienna initiated by Austrian mobile phone provider “3”. More than 60 dedicated divers gave up a day of their free time in a concerted move to clear the Danube of accumu- lated rubbish. BAUER supported this outstanding commitment by providing the divers with breathing air on site. A team from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN in Austria and Munich took a VERTICUS com- pressor along to the Cleanup Day sup- ply tent on the riverbank and fired it up. With a charging rate of 540 litres per minute, the VERTICUS easily coped with the breathing air supplies needed for repeated dives, even during the peak midday period.
